In addition, we sell products from up and coming and innovative manufacturers whose products we evaluate very carefully before offering them to our customers.
about:
AAW Auto Parts has operated from Pasco, Washington since 1996. The family‑owned and operated business was established to serve the automotive aftermarket across South Eastern Washington, and it remains under family stewardship today.

The company functions as a wholesale and retail distributor, stocking more than 550,000 auto parts and accessories for domestic and foreign vehicles in a 15,000‑square‑foot facility. In addition to traditional counter and jobber sales, AAW offers delivery to commercial accounts, a retail walk‑in counter, and a specialized ECU reprogramming service covering OBD‑II General Motors and Chrysler control modules. Staff experience is emphasized: counter personnel average more than 15 years in the industry, and the leadership team includes CEO/Sales Director Bill Astley, Sales Manager Don Webb, and driver/Ebay specialist Wanita Harris.

Customers range from independent repair shops and fleet operators buying at wholesale to DIY consumers purchasing at retail. The catalog draws on relationships with established aftermarket brands — many with 20 to 50 years of manufacturing history — as well as newer suppliers vetted before inclusion. Manufacturers ship direct from warehouses nationwide, a model AAW says reduces markup and accelerates delivery.

The firm cites its family structure as a cost advantage, avoiding corporate overhead and passing savings to buyers. Its stated mission is to deliver the correct part on the first attempt, backed by overnight shipping on most stock orders and a commitment to long‑term customer retention.

old_description: At ABE Equipment, we pride ourselves in offering complete turnkey solutions for our customers. We don’t just sell products; we sell solutions! Sure, we design and assemble brewhouses, canning lines, distillation equipment, and more – but we craft each piece of equipment with the end goal in mind, which is designing a product that will help you make money. Our turnkey brewing systems and turnkey distillery offerings allow you to hit the ground running and focus on profits, not scrambling to source equipment from various vendors. When you choose ABE Equipment as your beverage equipment manufacturer, you’ve partnered with an international company backed by 30+ years of rich history. At ABE, we provide our clients with the opportunity for success by developing lasting partnerships. We are fully invested in your business’s growth from the initial startup to your equipment’s ongoing maintenance. You can always count on us to provide the equipment, services, and expertise you need to succeed.
about:
ABE Equipment is headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska. The business traces its roots to Norland International, a supplier of turnkey beverage equipment with nearly 30 years of industry experience. Originally operating as American Beer Equipment, the company rebranded to ABE Beverage Equipment in 2020 and shortened to ABE Equipment in 2022 to reflect its expanding portfolio beyond beer.

The company designs and assembles complete beverage production systems, including brewhouses, canning lines, distillation equipment, cellar tanks, filling machines, keg cleaners, and labelers. Operations are housed on a 140,000-square-foot campus that includes fabrication, production, warehouse, and office space. A staff of 135 employees — among them degreed electrical and mechanical engineers — provides engineering, layout, startup, training, and ongoing parts support.

ABE serves a range of craft beverage producers, including breweries, distilleries, kombucha makers, cider houses, cold-brew coffee operations, seltzer brands, infused-beverage companies, craft soda bottlers, and wineries. Customers span startup entrepreneurs launching their first facility to established producers expanding capacity.

The company emphasizes a dedicated customer-service team of ten who also function as training technicians, free equipment layout services, and a sales force with over 80 years of combined industry experience. Its stated mission is to deliver cutting-edge innovations and service so entrepreneurs can maximize their opportunities to succeed.

name: ACC Electronix, Inc
old_description: ACC manufactures ruggedized products that operate in the toughest environments
about:
ACC Electronix, Inc. was founded in 1981 in Normal, Illinois. The company operates from a facility and has accumulated over four decades of experience in electronics manufacturing.

The company provides a full range of electronics manufacturing services, including circuit card assembly (surface-mount and through-hole), full box build, product design and engineering support, depot repair, remanufacturing, and fulfillment. Its production floor is equipped for 0201 SMT placement, micro BGA, 3D solder paste inspection, 12-zone reflow ovens, X-ray inspection for BGA and BTC packages, and automated through-hole assembly. Technicians are certified to IPC J-STD-001 Rev G and IPC 7711/7721, and work follows IPC A-610 Class 2 and Class 3 acceptability standards. The facility handles both hand-built prototypes and high-volume production runs.

ACC serves customers in construction and mining (electronics for mining equipment), agriculture (tractors and planting equipment), HVAC and industrial (controls and human-machine interfaces), and energy (solar and wind power systems for electrified machines and grids). Testimonials on its site reference a major mining company and an agriculture customer.

The company emphasizes a flexible and adaptable workforce and equipment set, aiming to create partnering relationships that help customers achieve quality improvement, on-time delivery, inventory control, and cost reduction. It offers a custom formula for each client's success, from early design-for-manufacturability assistance through final assembly and test.

old_description: We believe you deserve a true collaborator that will work with you through each phase of your project. Since 1984, we’ve helped clients get over 11,000 projects from idea to reality.
about:
ACDi Manufacturing Plant operates in Branford, Connecticut, and was founded in 1984. The company began as an electronics manufacturing services provider, focusing on printed circuit board assembly and design. Over the past four decades it has completed more than 11,000 projects for clients across multiple sectors.

The facility offers a full range of PCB and systems manufacturing capabilities, including surface-mount and through-hole assembly, both leaded and lead-free processes, box builds, electromechanical assembly, chassis and rack-level integration, press-fit and custom mechanical work, and automated cable production. Additional services encompass conformal coating, protective finishes, testing and inspection, compliance and life-cycle support, obsolescence mitigation, materials procurement, and customized kitting and packaging. PCB layout is provided through a partnership with LogiSync, and the company supports new product introduction from prototype through production scaling.

ACDi serves the aerospace and defense industries, as well as government programs requiring ITAR compliance. Its quality system is certified to AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015, and the company is ITAR registered to handle sensitive defense and government work.

The company positions itself as a true collaborator that works with customers through every project phase, emphasizing an "Honor the Schedule" pledge to meet agreed timelines and an end-to-end, USA-based manufacturing model that keeps projects in-house from concept to completion.

about:
AIROS Medical, Inc. is headquartered in Norristown, Pennsylvania, and was founded in 2011. The company does not publicly disclose its founders or ownership structure.

The company develops FDA-cleared pneumatic compression therapy systems for home use, including the AIROS 6 and AIROS 8 devices and associated garments for upper extremity, lower extremity, and truncal treatment. A team of medical technology designers, engineers, quality control specialists, and clinical advisors collaborates on device development. The product line also includes the ARTAIRA arterial compression device for peripheral arterial disease and truncal garments offered in six- and eight-chamber configurations across expanded size ranges.

AIROS Medical serves patients with lymphedema, venous insufficiency, breast cancer-related edema, lipedema, and peripheral arterial disease (PAD). Its products are distributed through durable medical equipment (DME) suppliers and prescribed by clinicians seeking home-based compression therapy options.

The company states that its devices blend advanced medical technology with clinical direction drawn from decades of industry experience, aiming to drive positive patient outcomes through reliable, easy-to-use home therapy.

name: AKAS Textiles & Laminations
about:
AKAS Textiles & Laminations operates from Bensalem, Pennsylvania, where it was founded in 2007 as a closely-held enterprise. The company began with a mission to revive American textile manufacturing by sourcing every fiber domestically and partnering exclusively with U.S. mills, aiming to return pride and global leadership to the industry.

The company designs and manufactures high-performance fabrics, offering proprietary textiles for global clients and stocking first-quality roll goods of its own designs. Its capabilities span knitting and weaving, dyeing, laminating, backing, napping, cutting, printing, and applying specialized finishes for odor, stain, water resistance, and fire retardancy. An integrated supply chain eliminates middlemen, enabling low minimums and quick turnaround, while sustainable practices avoid harmful solvents and chemicals.

AKAS serves athletics, apparel, automotive, furniture, industrial, healthcare, hospitality, military, and food industries. Its fabrics have been used in space missions with U.S. astronauts, the Winter Olympics torch, and gear for the armed forces. Customers range from entrepreneurs like James McCrimmon (Draft Saver drink insulator) and Dr. David Pensak (Pensak Technologies) to strategic partners such as Dow, DuPont, and Invista, leveraging technologies like SILVADUR™, Teflon®, and Lycra®.

The company’s differentiation rests on its end-to-end domestic supply chain, over 100 years of combined experience in fiber engineering, and a personal commitment to quality that has driven double-digit annual growth since 2007. By controlling every step from raw material to finished roll, AKAS aims to deliver American-made textiles that meet mil-spec, food-safe, and flame-retardant standards.

AM General is headquartered in South Bend, Indiana, where it operates as a military and commercial automotive manufacturer.

The company provides engineering services, integrated logistics support, system technical support, and global aftermarket support. Its Aftermarket Fulfillment and Training Center (AFTC) in South Bend spans 210,000 square feet and manages more than 10,000 part numbers for customers in over 70 countries. Facilities also include a 320-acre off-road training course, classrooms, hands-on technical training bays, and driving simulators. AM General performs complete vehicle assembly and contract vehicle assembly, including partnerships for vehicles such as the 12-ton Bastion armored personnel carrier and the Jeep Gladiator XMT concept truck.

AM General serves the U.S. military, international defense customers, and commercial clients. Its integrated logistics support covers the Humvee family of vehicles, medium and heavy tactical trucks, bridging equipment, mine-detection vehicles, and petroleum and water supply systems. The company's aftermarket parts distribution supports U.S. Defense, international, and commercial customers worldwide.

AM General emphasizes its unmatched engineering experience and technical expertise, citing the U.S. Defense Logistics Agency's Outstanding Readiness Support Award in the large business category as recognition of its award-winning support.

name: AMERICAN ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT, INC.
old_description: For 40 years, American Electric Equipment Inc. & Control Products Inc. have delivered custom transformers, switchgear, explosion-proof equipment, and Yaskawa high-voltage breakers to mining and industrial operations across the region.
about:
American Electric Equipment Inc. (AEEI) and its sister division Control Products Inc. (CPI) have operated from Beckley, West Virginia since 1985. The company is American owned and operated, with roots in mining and underground power distribution, and has expanded into broader industrial and commercial markets over more than 40 years.

The company designs and builds custom dry-type transformers (12,470 V down to 120 V), high-voltage switchgear including the ISOVAC 800 (15 kV, 800 A), ground monitors, power centers, substations, and its own ProVac medium-voltage vacuum circuit breaker. It also reconditions and services Yaskawa SF6 gas circuit breakers (5–15 kV) with factory-trained technicians. An OMAX 120X abrasive waterjet with a 26'8" × 10' work area provides precision cutting of steel, stainless, aluminum, titanium, composites, glass, and stone for custom brackets, gaskets, plates, and signage. Additional services include Kohler generator sales, sizing, installation, and maintenance; excavation, construction, and demolition; erosion control and site reclamation; and on-site field service and engineering repair.

Primary customers are mining operations and industrial facilities requiring underground power distribution systems, as well as commercial and industrial sites needing standby power. The explosion-proof product line under CPI — enclosures, control stations, and junction boxes — is engineered and certified for hazardous, gassy mining environments.

The company emphasizes its dual-division structure (AEEI electrical equipment plus CPI explosion-proof products), deep mining expertise, and the combination of custom manufacturing with certified field service. It positions itself as a single source for engineered equipment, fabrication, and on-site support, all built and serviced to customer specifications.
